thread:
neha_cs: Dropping a concise enterprise-focused 'renewal rescue' micro-runbook. Target: CSMs handling regulated/private-deploy customers. Keep it pasteable into customer comms + quick ops snippets.

omar_sre: +1. include KMS/HSM checks and private-control-plane notes (customers often misconfigure KMS and blame latency).

susan_se: also add the recommended streaming fallback for on-prem SDKs and a short prefill tuning note for low-throughput tenants.

neha_cs: draft CSM checklist (6 bullets):
- verify deployment mode: Private (VPC/on-prem) vs Dedicated vs Hosted
- confirm KMS integr (if private): key rotation status OK and latency through KMS < 200ms
- prefill: enabled for demo flows; TTL tuned to tenant idle (default 30s for enterprise)
- streaming: enabled for interactive UIs; include client fallback snippet in onboarding email
- collect 3 business-critical prompts + acceptance criteria for each flow
- escalation trigger: activation lag >2 incidents OR 95p latency >SLA for 7d -> flag RenewalRisk

ben_pm: For RenewalRisk tagging, suggest this rule: 2 incidents in 7d OR avg 95p latency > SLA*1.5 for 14d -> auto-tag CRM but require CSM review. Add a sentence to notify Account Exec before outreach.

omar_sre: SRE triage steps to paste in ticket (quick):
1) confirm infra: private control plane healthy, network egress to KMS within budget
2) run these quick queries (pseudocode):
```
# quick infra checks
kms_latency = query("avg(kms_request_duration_seconds{tenant=\"X\"}[15m])")
lat95 = query("histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[1h])) by (le))")
prefill_hit_rate = query("sum(prefill_hits{tenant=\"X\"}) / sum(prefill_requests{tenant=\"X\"})")
```
3) if kms_latency > 0.2s -> route to infra + customer network team; if lat95 > baseline*2 -> increase prefill pool and enable extra batch workers

susan_se: pasteable client fallback snippet for private/on-prem SDKs (short):
```
// on-prem streaming fallback (pasteable)
if (sdk.streamAvailable()) {
  sdk.startStream(flowId);
} else if (sdk.prefillReady(flowId)) {
  sdk.applyPrefill(flowId);
} else {
  sdk.callSync(flowId, {timeout: 8s});
}
```

neha_cs: added VOC capture line: "after go-live, send 3-question pulse: latency ok?, results match expectations?, which 1-2 flows would you call 'mission-critical'?" Tie responses back into model/prefill tuning.

ben_pm: add a short mitigation cookbook when a recent change caused regression: rollback quantization/weights, revert routing policy, temporarily pin to previous model version. Also include who owns each step (SRE rollback, SE customer config, PM product decision).

omar_sre: include quick mitigations list for ticket: bump prefill pool, enable safe-fallback, add batch workers, temporarily restrict max_tokens_per_request for heavy tenants.

neha_cs: final paragraph for CSMs: "When to escalate: first outreach by CSM (customer comms + samples), if config change required involve SE, if infra/network/KMS issues involve SRE, if repeated accuracy regressions involve PM. Keep messages short and include runbook link and sample prompts."
